entries.description: A 93-acre property with camping space and woods owned by two lesbians. Welcomes girl children, non-lesbian women, and future new members. Substance-free.
entries.raw_text: We welcome: new members/residents (in future), girl children, nonlesbian women. No drugs, alcohol, tobacco. We have/are: 2 lesbians, 93 acres, camping space, woods.
entries.notes: Continues from previous page. Type is Private/Individual Land per the two-woman rule ('2 lesbians'). num_residents is left blank because the listing does not state that the women are living on the land. Accepted groups include Lesbian women (directory context), Non-lesbian women ('nonlesbian women'), and Girl children ('girl children'). Focus is Recovery/substance-free ('No drugs, alcohol, tobacco').

entries.description: A residential course and retreat center on 10 acres offering educational programs, apprenticeships, and retreats for women from spring to fall.
entries.raw_text: HARDSCRABBLE HILL CENTER Box 130-Castine Rd, Orland, ME 04472 (207)469-7112. From Spring to Fall our intensive residential courses and retreats for women expand the heart, challenge thinking, and offer practical tools and experience. We welcome: new members/residents, workshop participants, workshop guides, internships-apprentices, staff, private retreatants, artists in residence. We welcome all wild women, whatever stage or age on the feminist journey, creating new names as we go. We have: 10 acres of land adjoining several hundred wild, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity in some buildings, camping space, woods, bio-dynamic garden, women living and workin' the land.
entries.notes: Type is Retreat/Gathering Space as an educational and retreat center (specifically named in codebook). Land address inferred from road in contact address. num_residents is left blank because no count of women living on the land is specified. Acreage excludes the adjoining wild land ('adjoining several hundred wild'). Accepted groups include Lesbian women and Non-lesbian women based on pre-1986 inclusive phrasing ('all wild women'). Focus is Workshops/education ('intensive residential courses and retreats', 'workshop participants, workshop guides, internships-apprentices'). Bio-dynamic garden from questionnaire is not coded as focus.

entries.description: Private land of 30 acres owned by a small family of two lesbians and two girl children, offering hiking and camping for lesbian campers, with roadside camping accessible to differently abled lesbians. Substance-free.
entries.raw_text: LINDA TISDALE/CAROL SHOREBORN RFD 2 Box 3085, Dexter, ME 04930 (207)924-5172. We are a small family of 2 lesbians, 2 girl children, 1 dog, 4 cats, 1 horse (soon to be more). We've cleared trails for hiking, picnics, camping, etc. Our 30 acres is surrounded by 100's of acres of unused, undeveloped land at present. We currently have no housing for other lesbian visitors but we welcome campers. Must be able to hike to campsite carry all needs in and out! Camping available near road for differently abled lesbians. We do not smoke, drink, use drugs. We welcome: girl children (boys by invitation only!), nonlesbian women, dogs. We have/are: 2 lesbians, 2 girl children, 30 acres of land, housing/permanent structures, electricity, well water, outhouse, camping space, woods, women living and workin' on the land.
entries.notes: Type is Private/Individual Land per the two-woman rule. Contact name taken from heading names. Land address inferred from RFD address. Surrounding undeveloped land noted but not included in acreage. num_residents is 4 (2 lesbians plus 2 girl children, confirmed by 'women living and workin' on the land'). Accepted groups include Lesbian women (directory context, 'lesbian visitors'), Non-lesbian women ('nonlesbian women'), Girl children ('girl children'), and Boy children ('boys by invitation only!'). Focuses are Disabled women ('Camping available near road for differently abled lesbians') and Recovery/substance-free ('We do not smoke, drink, use drugs').

entries.description: A 143-acre retreat and healing space offering primitive camping, swimming ponds, and a sauna in progress.
entries.raw_text: NORTHWOODS RD 1 Box 156, Alpine, NY 14805. This is additional info to our listing in VI,2. We can offer retreat and healing space mostly in the form of primitive camping - $2 to $5 a day if you can. Our accessibility is unfortunately poor (143 acres almost all uphill.) We'll probably have a visitor' kitchen so please bring your own food, the sauna is in progress and both ponds are fine for swimming. Work is welcomed. Chemicals are discouraged.
entries.notes: Type is Retreat/Gathering Space ('retreat and healing space'). Land address inferred from RD address. num_residents is blank as none are stated. Accepted groups include Lesbian women through directory context. 'Chemicals are discouraged' is noted but not coded as Recovery/substance-free or Environmentalism/eco-friendly because it expresses a preference rather than a defined rule or practice. Poor accessibility is explicitly stated so Disabled women is not coded.

entries.description: A private 20-acre homestead and farm operated by one woman, with beef and dairy cows, chickens, bees, and gardens. Open to lesbian and non-lesbian visitors for short work-exchange visits; substance-free and rejects separatism.
entries.raw_text: ONEIDA FARM RD 5, Dillsburg, PA 17019 (717)432-2157. (Between Harrisburg and Gettysburg.) I am a homesteader/farmer/carpenter on 20 acres with cows (beef and milk), chickens, bees, fruit trees, garden I am not a separatist and cannot accomodate flag-waving, breast-baring sisters. Visits (limited to 2-3 days) require work exchange. No drugs, cigarettes, pets, guns. Visitors are expected to bring own food, etc. Non-lesbian women welcome. I prefer that you telephone so that we get to know each other before we set up a visit. I have a house, barn, electricity, woods, farmland, pasture.
entries.notes: Type is Private/Individual Land ('I am a homesteader/farmer/carpenter on 20 acres'). Land address inferred from RD address. num_residents is 1 based on the single resident owner ('I am...'). Accepted groups include Lesbian women (directory context) and Non-lesbian women ('Non-lesbian women welcome'). Focuses include Farming/self-sufficiency ('cows (beef and milk), chickens, bees, fruit trees, garden', homesteading) and Recovery/substance-free ('No drugs, cigarettes'). Separatism is explicitly rejected ('I am not a separatist') and therefore not coded.

entries.description: A women's community and retreat center on 35 acres held in a land trust, with 6 buildings, woods, meadow, stream, organic gardens, and wood and solar heat. Welcomes visitors, new members, all women, and children.
entries.raw_text: HEATHCOTE WOMENS COMMUNITY 21300 Heathcote Rd, Freeland, MD 21053 (301)343-1070. We are a new wom'ns community/retreat center, 35 miles north of Baltimore. We have/are: 4 lesbians with a feminist perspective, support for political involvement, strong ties with Baltimore wom'ns community, 35 acres of woods, meadow, stream in a land trust, 6 buildings, organic gardens, bees, wood and solar heat, electricity/plumbing, camping and indoor space. We are developing the retreat center (facilities for up to 50) as a business to support the place and members. Local jobs are possible with wom'n landscaping company, wom'ns printing shop. Long and short term commitment. We welcome: visitors, new members, all women of all colours and persuasions, girl and boy children. It's a wonderful place and we want to share it!
entries.notes: Type is Land Trust because the land is held 'in a land trust'. Land address inferred from street road address. Distance to Baltimore omitted from land_location_as_stated per codebook. num_residents is left blank because the questionnaire count of 4 lesbians does not state women living on the land. Accepted groups include Lesbian women, Non-lesbian women ('all women of all colours and persuasions' pre-1986), Girl children, and Boy children ('girl and boy children'). Women of color is not coded because the phrase is a statement of inclusiveness. Focus is Environmentalism/eco-friendly for appropriate technology ('wood and solar heat').

entries.community_name: WE DON'T HAVE A NAME YET
entries.land_location_as_stated: Between Berkeley Springs, WV and Winchester, VA.
entries.description: A 20-acre property with a passive solar shell owned by two lesbian musicians. Welcomes non-lesbian women, children, and men, with a particular focus on music. Substance-free.
entries.raw_text: WE DON'T HAVE A NAME YET c/o Nan and Ruth, PO Box 63, Unger, WV 25447 (304)258-5079. (Between Berkeley Springs, WV and Winchester, VA.) We own 20 acres on which we built a passive solar shell this summer with the help of friends. We have to work away from the land at this point, but one of us is trying to find local work to be able to be more in touch with the land (small-scale farming and a few farm animals are a short-range goal). We are musicians & especially welcome non-competitive musicians and singers. We welcome: non-lesbian wimmin, girl & boy children (parental supervision a must), males, medium to small dogs (females only, please). Bring food to share. No drugs, tobacco, or heavy drinkers. We have/are: 2 lesbians, 20 acres, housing & permanent structures, electricity, camping space, woods, farmland, a male dog (does not get along with other male dogs), wimmin living (full time) and working (part time) on the land.
entries.notes: Type is Private/Individual Land per the two-woman rule ('2 lesbians', 'We own 20 acres'). PO box address leaves land street and zip blank; land city and state inferred from mailing town and stated location. num_residents is 2 ('2 lesbians', 'wimmin living (full time)... on the land'). Accepted groups include Lesbian women (directory context), Non-lesbian women ('non-lesbian wimmin'), Girl children ('girl & boy children'), Boy children ('girl & boy children'), Gay men, and Non-gay men ('males'). Focuses include Environmentalism/eco-friendly ('passive solar shell'), Recovery/substance-free ('No drugs, tobacco, or heavy drinkers'), Archives/cultural work ('We are musicians & especially welcome non-competitive musicians and singers'), and Farming/self-sufficiency ('small-scale farming and a few farm animals are a short-range goal').

entries.description: An intentional community of 3 to 5 women on 55 acres with two houses, barn, pond, and farmland in southeastern Ohio. Welcomes women and children for visits up to a week in exchange for work.
entries.raw_text: MOON RIDGE Rt 1 Box 240, Guysville, OH 45735. We are 3-5 wimmin on 55 acres in hilly southeastern Ohio. We have a house with electricity and a barn and another house under construction. We have dogs, cats, goats, gardens, woods, pond, camping space, farmland, wimmin living and working on and off the land. We welcome wimmin and children to stay up to a week for help with food and work exchange (house re-modeling - house building - daily survival chores).
entries.notes: Type is Intentional Community/Cooperative ('3-5 wimmin', house construction, shared community). Land address inferred from Rt 1 address. num_residents is coded as the lower number of the range (3 of 3-5), confirmed by 'wimmin living and working on and off the land'. Accepted groups include Lesbian women and Non-lesbian women ('wimmin' pre-1986), and Girl children and Boy children ('children'). Focuses list is empty as no specific ideological focus, rule, or programmatic purpose is stated.

entries.land_location_as_stated: near Virginia; Located in Northern Minnesota, ten miles from town
entries.description: Private land of 3 acres with a house, sauna, organic garden, and lake access, owned by one lesbian in northern Minnesota. Welcomes women of all ages for visits with work exchange or cash.
entries.raw_text: WHISPERING WINDS Rt 2 Box 8, Iron, MN 55751 (near Virginia). Country living with privacy for womyn. Located in Northern Minnesota, ten miles from town - access to a small lake. Company of womyn of all ages welcomed. Dogs if restrained. Visits require work exchange and/or cash. I am/have: 1 lesbian, 3+ acres, house/permanent structures, electricity, well, camping space, organic garden, sauna, 2 dogs, cat, woods.
entries.notes: Type is Private/Individual Land ('1 lesbian'). Land address inferred from Rt 2 address. Acreage recorded as 3 from '3+ acres'. num_residents is 1 ('1 lesbian'). Accepted groups include Lesbian women and Non-lesbian women ('Company of womyn of all ages welcomed' pre-1986). Older women is not coded because 'all ages' is general age inclusiveness rather than centering older women. Organic garden from questionnaire is not coded as a focus.
